title: Boynton Harbor Marina

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Boynton Beach is known as the “Gateway to the Gulf Stream” because of its close proximity and easy access to the Atlantic waters. The Boynton Harbor Marina is home to the finest charter fishing operations in South Florida. We welcome you to discover the tropical paradise that awaits in beautiful Boynton Beach. Book your next deep-sea voyage with one of our commercial fishing charters

services.name: Scuba Diving Charters
services.desc: The Boynton Harbor Marina offers many scuba diving opportunities that include scuba diving instructions and daily diving charters off the Palm Beach County coastline to maximize your diving pleasure. With the Gulf Stream’s rich currents, the reefs offer many different species of colorful fish, corral, moray eels and turtles.
